description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that contains a LogView and manages its display within a ScrollView. It handles view creation, layout setup, and text change events to facilitate logging UI in an Android app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a LogView inside a ScrollView, managing log output and view layout.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on log updates, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
